🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
power计算 x 的 y 次方

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 overnight_downside：overnight_ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2)
  2. 计算 intraday_downside：intraday_ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2)
  3. 计算 overnight_energy：overnight_downside.滚动窗口(30, min_periods=30).sum()
  4. 计算 total_energy：(overnight_downside + intraday_downside).滚动窗口(30, min_periods=30).sum()
  5. 计算 concentration：overnight_energy / total_energy
  6. 计算 stress_scale：np.sqrt(total_energy)
  7. 计算 factor：-(concentration * stress_scale)
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_overnight_stress_concentration_30(df): """Measures accumulated downside stress concentrated ">class="kw">in overnight gaps over a stabilized horizon.""" df_copy = df.copy() overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"]) overnight_downside = overnight_ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2) intraday_downside = intraday_ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2) overnight_energy = overnight_downside.rolling(30, min_periods=30).sum() total_energy = (overnight_downside + intraday_downside).rolling(30, min_periods=30).sum() concentration = overnight_energy / total_energy.replace(0.0, np.nan) stress_scale = np.sqrt(total_energy) factor = -(concentration * stress_scale) "kw">class="kw">return factor.rename("factor_overnight_stress_concentration_30")
